question: Estimate the daily food delivery orders pan-India (Swiggy + Zomato + Magicpin combined).
idealClarificationQuestions: Total country-wide daily orders combined? Yes.
Average weekday or weekend? Average day across the year.
Include only food delivery (exclude Instamart, Blinkit, Hyperpure)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: addressable population → frequency segmented → annual orders → daily.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total food delivery active users in India (used in last quarter): ~120M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: These questions probe usage patterns: frequency, session length, DAU, message volume. The trap is over-estimating — most users use most apps far less than power users. Always segment heavy / medium / light and weight by share, then cross-check with operator disclosures.
